title: Hellbound Artist Kyoo-seok Choi Teams Up With MEEN for New Webtoon Crocodile
content: Kakao Entertainment announced on Friday that Crocodile , a new action noir webtoon created by MEEN and Hellbound artist Kyoo-seok Choi, will launch on Kakao Page on September 5. The series marks the first collaboration between the two creators.
author: ANN

title: 'Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. Season 2' Reveals Additional Cast, New Staff, Theme Songs, Third Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nigojuu 's Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. ( The Detective Is Already Dead ) revealed additional cast, new staff, the theme songs and third promotional video for the second season on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 7 at 9.30 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: WEBTOON's Parent Company Naver Invests in Emmy-Winning Animation Studio Baobab Studios
content: Naver Ventures, the U.S.-based venture investment arm of NAVER, the parent company of WEBTOON Entertainment, announced on Wednesday it has made a strategic investment in Baobab Studios ( Namoo, Crow: The Legend, The Witchverse ), the 10-time Emmy-winning transmedia animation studio.
author: ANN

title: Webtoon-Based Animated Film Guardians of the Video Game to Open in October in Korea
content: LOCUS Animation Studio announced on August 20 it will release Guardians of the Video Game , a theatrical animated film based on Gasfard's webtoon of the same name, in theaters across South Korea in October. The film follows Patch, an ace agent responsible for setting up worlds inside video games.
author: ANN

title: The Elusive Samurai Anime's 2nd Season Casts Niina Hanamiya
content: The staff for the second television anime season based on Yūsei Matsui 's The Elusive Samurai ( Nigejōzu no Wakagimi ) manga revealed on Friday that Niina Hanamiya is joining the cast as Mima. The new season began airing on July 17 at 11:30 p.m.
author: ANN

title: My Girlfriend's Friend TV Anime Reveals More Cast, October 4 Debut in Video
content: The official website for the television anime of Jura 's My Girlfriend's Friend ( Kanojo no Tomodachi ) manga revealed more cast, the main promotional video, and the October 4 debut for the series on Friday. Note: The below video is not safe for work.
author: ANN

title: 'Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Isle Oosaki 's Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku ( Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers ) light novel revealed additional cast, a key visual (pictured), and the theme songs on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Releases Creditless Second Anime Ending Featuring "ONE NIGHT STAR" by The ARROWS
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its second ending, featuring the song “ONE NIGHT STAR” by The ARROWS. The song was used in Episodes 13-29, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe' Announces Supporting Cast, Additional Staff
content: The official website of the Soukou Kihei Votomos: Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms: Die Graue Hexe ) anime announced supporting cast and additional staff members on Friday. The anime will premiere as two movies, with the first one scheduled to open in theaters on November 20.
author: MyAnimeList

title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 47 Preview Images and Synopsis Revealed
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 7 (Episode 47 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes. The fifth episode is titled “THE END 2,” and it will premiere on Saturday, September 5.
author: Anime Corner
